evidence_candidates.excerpt: The FY2026 ASCR request supports ESnet6 operation and Integrated Research Infrastructure development. It provides no line-item construction funding for the High Performance Data Facility, instead retaining a phased final-design approach, and describes continuing AI, advanced-computing and quantum coordination.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Public supercomputing plans are being reshaped by AI and data-infrastructure demand while funding, procurement and component-supply constraints alter deployment paths.
